# The beehave process dies during the implement step. The next beehave run finishes the same run
# and does not repeat the plan step.
env REPO=o/r BASE=integration OWNER_LOGIN=owner OWNER_EMAIL=owner@example.com SOURCE_CHECKOUT=/own/checkout
! exec beehave run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star &
waitfile started
kill -KILL
wait

exec beehave status
stdout '^item-7-r1\trunning\tnow '

exec beehave run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star
stdout 'item 7 finished'

exec beehave status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone\tmerge: merged'
! stdout 'item-7-r2'

grep -count=1 '^plan ' calls.log
grep -count=2 '^implement ' calls.log
grep -count=2 '^review ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^fix ' calls.log

cmp events.log expected-events.log

-- hang --
implement
-- verdicts --
approve
approve
-- expected-events.log --
claim 7
ready 7
release 7
